P-COVIDOUT-2023.correction: The journal issued a correction (PMID 37666258). Conflicting cumulative-incidence values make the absolute risk reduction uncertain.
P-COVIDOUT-2023.decisiveLimit: The long-term follow-up population was selected from an acute-infection trial. An indexed correction and conflicting cumulative-incidence values limit interpretation of the absolute effect.

P-ACTIV6-2026.decisiveLimit: Few long-term events, 593 missing symptom outcomes and a secondary diagnosis endpoint limit precision and interpretation.

P-KOREA-2026.preview: A two-week metformin course did not improve eight-week recovery from established Long COVID: 84/132 participants recovered with metformin and 90/132 with placebo.
P-KOREA-2026.decisiveLimit: The trial concerns the tested short course and population; its results may not apply to more severe or persistent illness.

P-RECOVER-2026.preview: RECOVER-VITAL compared extended nirmatrelvir–ritonavir treatment with control in selected Long COVID symptom groups and did not show a significant primary benefit.
P-RECOVER-2026.decisiveLimit: The symptom groups had different primary outcomes, so the findings require endpoint-specific interpretation.

P-REVIVE-2026.preview: The original REVIVE report has a notice of retraction and republication and is excluded from efficacy conclusions.
P-REVIVE-2026.correction: Retraction and republication notice: 6 October 2026, PMID 42832813, DOI 10.7326/ANNALS-26-03050. The original findings are not reliable evidence for a benefit conclusion.
P-REVIVE-2026.decisiveLimit: The original report was retracted for republication.

CP017.preview: An exploratory companion analysis of a metformin schizophrenia trial examined serum metabolites and brain connectivity. Associations with cognitive scores suggest possible mechanisms but cannot establish mediation.

CP018.decisiveLimit: This 2023 narrative review predates the 2025 MET-PREVENT trial and summarizes heterogeneous populations and exercise regimens.

CP027.preview: A textbook account of drug-repurposing investigations, including itraconazole in several cancers.
CP027.decisiveLimit: The chapter summarizes other reports; its narrative is separate from the methods and results of the original studies.

CP028.preview: A textbook source discussing repurposing mechanisms and investigations, including cancer research.
CP028.decisiveLimit: A secondary account of original experiments and studies.
